gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.05 to 100.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 2 to 200 Hz.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 3 s.

p_soft.label: Breath, soft
p_soft.hover: The blowing pressure at the lightest touch, relative to where the tone just speaks: above 1 it always speaks, below 1 a light touch is only air. Range 0.5 to 3.

p_loud.label: Breath, loud
p_loud.hover: The blowing pressure at a full press: higher is louder and brighter, and pushes the tone harder. Range 0.1 to 3.

p_reg.label: Breath by register
p_reg.hover: How the blowing pressure changes going up the range: above 0 the high notes get more air. Range -1 to 1.

p_curve.label: Breath curve
p_curve.hover: The shape of the curve from key pressure to blowing pressure: below 1 soft playing is easier, above 1 the loud end comes later. Range 0.3 to 3.

reed_hz.label: Reed resonance
reed_hz.hover: Where the reed's own resonance sits. Range 200 to 8000 Hz.

reed_reg.label: Reed resonance by register
reed_reg.hover: How the reed resonance follows the register, in octaves per octave. Range -1 to 1.5 octaves.

reed_q.label: Reed damping
reed_q.hover: How much the lips damp the reed: low is damped and smooth, high is free and edgy. Range 0.3 to 30.

reed_open.label: Reed opening
reed_open.hover: How open the reed tip rests, at the reference note. Range 0.05 to 2.5 mm.

open_reg.label: Opening by register
open_reg.hover: How much smaller the reed's opening gets per octave up. Range -1 to 1.5 octaves.

reed_w.label: Reed width
reed_w.hover: How wide the reed tip is. Range 2 to 25 mm.

p_close.label: Closing pressure
p_close.hover: The blowing pressure that closes the reed: the blades' stiffness. Range 1 to 40 kPa.

contact.label: Blade contact
contact.hover: How stiff the blades are when they beat against each other. Range 0 to 50.

duct.label: Duct
duct.hover: The reed's narrow duct: the opening where it starts to choke the air. Range 0.05 to 5 mm.

emb_tilt.label: Bite by timbre
emb_tilt.hover: How much timbre bites the reed: up pinches it. Range -1 to 1 octaves.

emb_soft.label: Pinch when soft
emb_soft.hover: How far the lips pinch the reed at the lightest breath, relaxing to the full opening when loud. Range 0.1 to 1.

bite.label: Bite pitch
bite.hover: How far biting pulls the pitch as timbre moves. Range -100 to 100 cents.

jitter.label: Jitter
jitter.hover: A fine, fast roughness of the pitch, like a living lip. Range 0 to 40 cents.

wander.label: Breath wander
wander.hover: How unsteady the breath is: the slow and fast fluctuation of a sustained tone. Range 0 to 0.3.

lip_wander.label: Lip wander
lip_wander.hover: How unsteady the lips are on a sustained tone. Range 0 to 0.3.

wander_hz.label: Wander speed
wander_hz.hover: How fast the breath and lips wander. Range 0.3 to 30 Hz.

ref_note.label: Reference note
ref_note.hover: The note the instrument's parameters are measured at. Range 24 to 96 MIDI note.

apex.label: Cone apex
apex.hover: How far the reed sits from the cone's apex. Range 0.5 to 80 cm.

cavity.label: Reed cavity
cavity.hover: The air volume of the reed and staple, relative to the missing tip of the cone. Range 0 to 4.

bore_d.label: Bore diameter
bore_d.hover: How wide the tube is at the reed. Range 1.5 to 15 mm.

bore_decay.label: Bore decay
bore_decay.hover: How long the tube's resonance rings: the bloom and the tail. Range 0.003 to 0.3 s.

bore_reg.label: Bore by register
bore_reg.hover: How much shorter the tube's ring gets per octave up. Range -1 to 2 octaves.

lattice_hz.label: Tone-hole cutoff
lattice_hz.hover: The frequency above which the open tone holes stop reflecting: the wind tone's brightness. Range 100 to 6000 Hz.

lattice_q.label: Cutoff sharpness
lattice_q.hover: How sharp the tone-hole cutoff is. Range 0.4 to 4.

lattice_reg.label: Cutoff by register
lattice_reg.hover: How the tone-hole cutoff follows the register, in octaves per octave. Range -1 to 1.5 octaves.

rad_hz.label: Radiation low cut
rad_hz.hover: The frequency below which the instrument radiates less. Range 10 to 3000 Hz.

tone_hz.label: Tone
tone_hz.hover: The brightness of the radiated tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 300 to 16000 Hz.

tone_q.label: Tone sharpness
tone_q.hover: How sharp the tone roll-off is. Range 0.5 to 3.

breath.label: Breath noise
breath.hover: The audible breath in the tone. Range 0 to 1.

hiss.label: Hiss
hiss.hover: The steady hiss of the air. Range 0 to 0.5.

t_noise.label: Tongue "t"
t_noise.hover: The short noise burst of a tongued start. Range 0 to 1.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a hard strike sharpens the start: the tongue's hold and release, the accent and the "t". Range 0 to 2.

att_rate.label: Attack speed by strike
att_rate.hover: How much a hard strike quickens the attack: how fast the tongue lets the reed go and how far it had held it shut. Range 0 to 2.

att_noise.label: Attack noise by strike
att_noise.hover: How much a hard strike adds to the "t" at the start. Range 0 to 2.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 1.5.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.005 to 0.3 s.

tongue_t.label: Tongue release
tongue_t.hover: How long the tongue takes to let the note go on a soft start; a hard strike is many times faster. Range 0.0005 to 0.05 s.

tongue_shut.label: Tongue on the reed
tongue_shut.hover: How far the tongue holds the reed shut on a tongued start. Range 0 to 1.2.

slur.label: Slur
slur.hover: How much articulation a legato note change gets: 0 seamless, 1 each new note is re-tongued. Range 0 to 1.

pitch_t.label: Pitch settling
pitch_t.hover: How fast the player's ear pulls the pitch to its centre after a start or a change. Range 0.002 to 0.5 s.

flutter.label: Flutter by shake
flutter.hover: How much flutter tongue a shake (the motion input) adds. Range 0 to 1.

flut_hz.label: Flutter rate
flut_hz.hover: How fast the flutter tongue rolls. Range 8 to 40 Hz.
